notes.title: Watch and control
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
This is interface and gamepad support update.
Changes:

 Gamepad support!
 Visual tutorial updated and supplemented
 HP line changed, icons of food and money changed
 Icons in phone market changed
 Difficulty choice is more obvious now
 Dialog colors and boxes changed
 Bullet hell car is more visible
 Dragons are slower
 Small visual bugs fixed
